description: This file defines models and a fetcher for retrieving and processing historical cryptocurrency data from the Tiingo API, including query parameter classes, data models, and data transformation methods.

classes.name: TiingoCryptoHistoricalQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for Tiingo crypto historical data requests, including date range, symbols, and exchange filters.

classes.name: TiingoCryptoHistoricalData
classes.description: Represents individual data points of historical crypto prices, including transaction count and volume.

classes.name: TiingoCryptoHistoricalFetcher
classes.description: Handles data fetching from Tiingo API, including transforming query parameters, retrieving raw data, and transforming it into structured data objects.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Transforms input parameters by setting default start and end dates if not provided.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches raw data from the Tiingo API endpoint using provided credentials and query parameters.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw API data into structured TiingoCryptoHistoricalData objects, handling multiple symbols and date formatting.
